'''1999 Decipher World Championship Maarten Logghe LS''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Maarten Logghe]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls93.htm MWHL-CC Mains Deck], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031004427/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls93.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
